research.community: Palm Central Private Residences · Palm Jebel Ali
overview: Stepped buildings face the water, with shared landscaped grounds and a beach-oriented leisure programme. The residential mix includes conventional apartments and duplex townhouses; their outdoor spaces and layouts differ substantially.
research.locationNote: On the spine of Palm Jebel Ali, between its fronds. This is a separate island development from Palm Jumeirah. Confirm the exact building, orientation, beach access arrangements and infrastructure delivery for the selected home.
research.priceNote: The official sheet lists AED 2.7m for one bedroom, AED 4.3m for two, AED 4.9m for two plus maid, AED 7.5m for three, AED 12.4m for four and AED 14.9m for a townhouse. These are category starting references, not confirmed current inventory or a unit quotation.
research.paymentNote: The displayed stages reproduce page 1 for one-bedroom, two-bedroom and two-bedroom-plus-maid homes: 20% booking, 50% subsequent instalments and 30% September 2030. Page 2 instead gives three-/four-bedroom apartments and townhouses 20% booking, 40% interim and 40% September 2030, with February and July 2028 each 5% rather than 10%. Request the schedule for the actual unit.
research.handoverNote: The current developer price/payment sheet states estimated construction completion in September 2030. It does not promise a contractual move-in date. Earlier portal references to 2029 and 20/ 30/ 50 terms relate to different or older marketing and must not replace this category-specific document.

facts.label: Release scope
facts.value: The 24 June 2026 release announces 222 homes across three buildings, following an initial October 2025 release. It describes one- to four-bedroom apartments and four- to five-bedroom townhouses.

facts.label: Townhouse configuration
facts.value: Type A drawings show four bedrooms and Type B five, with a separate maid room, internal lift shaft and a two-level layout. The plan does not establish that every lift is supplied or commissioned.

unresolved: No unit-specific current inventory, service charges, parking allocation or binding handover date was retrieved.
The official documents do not show a clear issue date. The payment sheet begins its future instalments in November 2026; confirm its validity and release before relying on it.
Quoted areas are selected drawing totals, not a development-wide minimum/maximum. Plans explicitly allow amendments. Images remain illustrative.
